title: Vanilla+ Starter Timeline
summary: A quiet Vanilla+ starter with guided Index, PlayerCore homes, HoloMap markers, TutorialCore hints, and a gentle MissionCore checklist.
body: Use this card to connect the first 10 minutes, first 30 minutes, and first 2 hours for Vanilla+ generated packs.
steps: Open Index and read the Vanilla+ welcome page.
Set a home or safe return point with PlayerCore.
Create one HoloMap marker for base, farm, mine, or village.
Finish a small shelter or base corner.
Mark a farm, mine, or village on the starter HoloMap layer.
